answer: At a juniper nursery on a terrace above an oasis, delivery agents bid for limited jobs. Require each accepted job to lock collateral until delivery is independently checked; a signed acceptance and missed deadline trigger a fixed loss. Extra aliases need extra locked capital, and splitting the same collateral cannot buy more jobs. Set the loss above the maximum gain from taking and abandoning a job, and delay release beyond the review window. This prices simultaneous abuse without pretending that one key equals one person.
